name: actionui
description: Generate and validate ActionUI JSON for macOS and iOS native UI. Use when the user asks to design, create, edit, fix, or verify ActionUI JSON files, or asks about ActionUI elements, properties, or layout.

claude.label: Claude (Anthropic Claude Code skill)
claude.notes: Delivered via Claude Code SKILL.md protocol. Full prose, tables OK, Anthropic XML tags allowed. Assume strong SwiftUI knowledge. Levels 1+2. Rely on schemas/ for element detail. Agent can run local Python validator.

capable.label: Capable frontier models (Gemini, Grok, GPT-4o, Llama-3-70B+)
capable.notes: Delivered as system prompt or tool description. No Anthropic-specific skill protocol. Standard Markdown only, no XML tags. Assume SwiftUI knowledge. Levels 1+2. Script execution may not be available; validation section adapts. Targets the current broad frontier: Gemini 2.x, Grok 3+, GPT-4o, strong open-source models. Will drift up as models improve — reassess annually.

lite.label: Small / local models (Phi-3, Mistral-7B, Llama-3-8B class)
lite.notes: Delivered as system prompt. No SwiftUI knowledge assumed. Level 1 only. Includes SwiftUI crash course and inline examples for few-shot prompting. Explicit keyword triggers in description. Tables stripped — prose and JSON snippets only.

content.description: What ActionUI is + JSON structure + core generation rules
One-paragraph note for SwiftUI-aware models: property names match SwiftUI modifiers
SwiftUI layout fundamentals crash course for non-SwiftUI agents
Universal View base properties reference (layout, appearance, interaction)
How to run the validator and what to do with errors
One-liner per element type with key properties and container shape
Short inline examples for few-shot prompting in lite/local flavor
Real-world layout and interaction patterns extracted from production ActionUI apps
Pointer to the docs/ subfolder: per-element schema docs, templates, and the JSON guide
